messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — noticed a ~420 GPU-hour spike in apac1 last night (02:00-05:00 UTC) that didn't map to any team tags. billing-bot alerted at 02:30 UTC. Can someone grab the owner?

billing-bot: [ALERT] Unattributed GPU usage detected: apac1 usg = 420h, untagged proportion = 78%. Suggested action: run nightly attribution query and open chargeback ticket. Link: https://billing.redwood/internal/alerts/1755554322 

Ravi Patel: Ugh. On it. I'll run the BQ export join now and paste the query. Might be runaway playground runs.

Ravi Patel: SQL snippet (quick):
```
SELECT pod_owner, project, SUM(gpu_hours) AS gpu_h
FROM `redwood-billing.gce.gpu_usage_v2`
WHERE region = 'apac1' AND usage_start >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
GROUP BY pod_owner, project
ORDER BY gpu_h DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Ravi Patel: Query shows top rows: `project=playground-sbox` (~260h, owner=null), `project=research-bert` (~90h, owner=Sarah Li), others small. Looks like playground runs didn't pick up tags after last deploy of autoscaler.

Sarah Li: Confirmed I own research-bert rows. Not our fault.

Alex Gomez: If playground is untagged we should map to cost-center:playground-temp until we sort tagging. Can finance accept a one-time reassignment to playground so teams don't get surprise bills? @Luis Ortega pls advise. :slightly_smiling_face:

Luis Ortega: Can do a one-time manual attribution, but need a short rationale + approval in ticket. Please include exact invoice date range and estimated $ impact.

Mia Chen: Estimated impact ~420 GPU-hours * $0.22/hr = ~$92.4 (apac pricing) before discounts. Date range 2026-03-22 02:00 - 2026-03-22 05:00 UTC. Rationale: autoscaler deploy removed label propagation; temporary mapping to playground-temp while eng fixes tagging.

Alex Gomez: OK I'll open a finance ticket with the above and tag infra and devex for a postmortem.

Ravi Patel: For infra: add this to the autoscaler rollback checklist and add a nightly lint to fail deploys that drop billing labels. Quick fix: re-enable label propagation in the autoscaler helm values (we reverted it last week).

Sarah Li: Can devex also add a dashboard alert for 'untagged_gpu > 50h/day per region' so ops gets an early ping?

Luis Ortega: Approved for manual attribution to playground-temp once ticket is created with the justification and cost estimate. I will attach a journal entry to the next internal invoice.

Mia Chen: Thanks. I'll follow up with the infra PR and the ticket: https://tickets.redwood/internal/FIN-4021 — tagging you all. :thumbsup: 

Alex Gomez: Nice. Postmortem owners: Ravi (query + fix), Alex (ticket + finance liaise), Mia (monitor).
